**Where the call goes:** `makeDecision` in `src/moderation/moderation.service.ts`, inside the two existing branches. I re-read the code and the notes' line numbers still hold.

- **Regular users:** in the `if (decisionActionDto.regularAction)` block (`:735-759`). Put it right after the `sseService.notifyStatusChanged(moderation.regularUserId, …)` call at `:750-758`.
- **Verified users:** in the `if (decisionActionDto.verifiedAction)` block (`:761-786`). Put it right after `notifyStatusChanged(moderation.verifiedUserId, …)` at `:776-785`.
- **Guests:** leave the guest branch (`:788-814`) alone, since product only asked for regular and verified users.

Both spots come after `suspendByModeration` has succeeded, so users are only notified once the suspension is saved.

**Method to call:** `FcmService.sendNotificationToUser(userId, notification: SendNotificationDto)` at `src/fcm/fcm.service.ts:172`.

- It looks up the user's active device token and sends via `sendNotificationToToken`.
- It returns `{ success: false }` if the user has no token. It throws `BadRequestException` on other failures.
- Wrap the call in its own try/catch and log the error. Otherwise a push failure would throw out of `makeDecision` before `moderationRepository.save` at `:816`, and the moderation decision wouldn't be saved.
- The existing KYC push at `fcm.service.ts:203-213` is the pattern to copy. It passes `data: { event: EventTypes.… }` using the enum in `src/fcm/enums/event-types.enum.ts`.
- I didn't find a suspension event type in `EventTypes`, so you'd add one, for example `USER_SUSPENDED`. Include the suspension type and whether it is 24h or permanent in `data`.

**Wiring needed:**

- `ModerationService` doesn't inject `FcmService`. Add it to the constructor (`:102-116`).
- Import `FcmModule` in `moderation.module.ts`. `FcmModule` already exports `FcmService` (`src/fcm/fcm.module.ts:12`). I didn't find an existing `FcmModule` import in the moderation module, so check for a circular dependency when you add it.

I didn't check the fields of `SendNotificationDto`. Look at it to see whether it takes `title` and `body` alongside `data`.
